tamperlog.description: My graduation project: a prototype for detecting changes to audit logs.
tamperlog.cardNote: Research prototype; not a production security guarantee.

grc-ai.description: I led a team building a local-AI prototype for reviewing policies against compliance frameworks.
grc-ai.cardNote: Hackathon prototype; national top five. AI output still needs human review.

localllm.description: A Flask interface for running Ollama models on your own machine.
localllm.cardNote: Runs offline after model download. Hardware needs depend on the model.

grc-check.description: A privacy and security self-assessment that keeps your answers on your device.
grc-check.cardNote: Self-assessment only; not a compliance certification or professional assessment.

privacy-check.description: See what your browser reveals about you and what you can change.

30-days.description: A little tracker for recurring payments. Because remembering every renewal date is not a skill I want to develop.

rss-ai.description: RSS feeds, summarized with local AI. A way to catch up without opening every tab.

token-speed.description: What does a token-per-second number actually feel like? This makes the difference visible.

clipguard.description: A clipboard utility built around a simple rule: what you copy should stay on your device.
